messages.content: Determine the winner in a Poker game with John having a Hand of 8♥, 10♥, J♥, Q♥, K♥ and Mike having 9♠, J♠, 10♠, Q♠, K♠.

function.name: card_games_poker_determine_winner
function.description: Determines the winner in a game of Poker based on the cards in each players' hands. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

hand1.description: The list of cards (as strings) in first player's hand. E.g ['10♠', 'J♠']

hand2.description: The list of cards (as strings) in second player's hand. E.g ['9♥', '10♥']

message.content:
Mike wins.  
Both hands are flushes with the same highest card (King).  
When comparing the next highest cards, Mike’s hand contains a 9, while John’s contains an 8.  
Since 9 > 8, Mike’s flush is higher and he wins the hand.
message.reasoning: We need to determine winner. John has 8♥,10♥,J♥,Q♥,K♥. That's a straight flush from 8 to K? Actually 8,10,J,Q,K missing 9. So it's not a straight flush. It's a flush (all hearts). Highest card K. Mike has 9♠,J♠,10♠,Q♠,K♠. That's also a flush (spades). Highest card K. But Mike has 9,10,J,Q,K. John's has 8,10,J,Q,K. So Mike's flush has higher kicker? Both have same high card K. Next compare next highest: both have Q, J, 10. John's has 8, Mike has 9. So Mike's 9 beats John's 8. So Mike wins. So answer: Mike wins.
